body:
Code looks good to me. This makes sense to do in the long run, since 32-bit is barely used to run Godot projects outside of WebAssembly these days.

Doing so will also free up space in the build matrix, so that official builds can be made faster and the export templates TPZ will be smaller. This extra space could in turn be reused to provide faster builds catering to modern CPUs (AVX2), while https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/59595 would be used to "upgrade" the current x86_64 binaries as the baseline. (There's still the challenge of providing some kind of automatic detection at startup though, e.g. using a launcher script that is generated on export to launch the correct binary.)

The list of possible returned values by `Engine.get_architecture_name()` should be updated: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/99f5a3d665cfcc517b0b4b55d8668c2116effb69/doc/classes/Engine.xml#L25
